user.title: Connect to SmartThings
user.description: Enter a SmartThings personal access token with permission to read devices. The integration only sends read-only API requests.

device.title: Choose a Samsung EHS heat pump
device.description: Only devices exposing Samsung EHS capabilities are listed.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid token or insufficient SmartThings permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach SmartThings. Try again later.
error.no_devices: No compatible Samsung EHS devices found with this token.

init.title: Samsung EHS settings
init.description: Select the Shelly (or other) power sensor measuring the heat pump. Supports W or kW. This replaces Samsung instantaneous power for live COP and daily energy/COP; seven-day electricity still uses the Samsung energy counter. Clear the selection to use Samsung again. If the chosen sensor is unavailable, live power and COP remain unknown without fallback. Enable the managed dashboard to add a sidebar dashboard for this heat pump. Sensor IDs are resolved automatically. Disable it to remove only the managed dashboard. Copy its configuration to a separate dashboard for customization.

error.own_sensor: Choose a sensor from another integration, such as Shelly, to avoid a circular dependency.
error.invalid_power_unit: The sensor must measure power in W or kW, not energy in Wh or kWh.
